name: SuperTokens
description: Open-source authentication service providing session management, social login, and passwordless sign-in.

envVars.description: Password for the SuperTokens Postgres database user
Comma-separated API keys required to call the SuperTokens core

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      POSTGRESQL_CONNECTION_URI: "postgresql://supertokens:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/supertokens"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      API_KEYS: {{env.API_KEYS}}
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: supertokens
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: supertokens
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
